title: EngagementUpdateDecided
description: Emitted by the Engagement Management Service when a user applies or declines a pending template update for an engagement. Consumed to clear reconciled versions from the Pending-Update Index, advance base_version, and append an immutable row to the per-firm Decision History.

engagement_id.description: Identifier of the engagement the decision applies to.

firm_id.description: Identifier of the firm the engagement belongs to.

decision.description: Outcome chosen by the user for the full accumulated chain head (all-or-nothing, not per intermediate version).

from_version.description: The engagement's base_version at the time of decision (version it was on before this decision).

to_version.description: The latest pending version the decision resolves to (chain head at decision time).

decided_by.description: Identifier of the authorized user who made the decision.

decided_at.description: UTC timestamp when the decision was recorded.
